recognize_zh: 成群的大型異常前骨髓球，細胞核呈雙葉或摺疊狀、兩葉互相重疊（sliding-plate / bilobed），細胞質紫色、顆粒細小到幾乎看不見，這是急性前骨髓球性白血病的低顆粒變異型（hypogranular APL）。
features: Large abnormal cells in cohesive-appearing clusters with moderate N:C ratio
Bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei with overlapping lobes (sliding-plate/butterfly shape)
Moderate violet to basophilic cytoplasm with very fine, dust-like granules or apparent agranularity
No obvious Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) in this field
Background red cells with mild crenation; platelets sparse
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of large abnormal cells with bilobed and folded nuclei whose lobes overlap in a sliding-plate or butterfly configuration. The chromatin is fine, nucleoli are inconspicuous, and the moderate violet cytoplasm appears hypogranular with only very fine dust-like granules. Auer rod bundles are not evident in this field and platelets appear sparse. Findings are highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant; urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts/promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, are MPO weak and NSE positive, and lack PML::RARA.
Cup-like blasts show a single punched-out nuclear invagination rather than bilobed overlapping lobes, and are PML::RARA negative though may be CD34/HLA-DR negative like APL.
Classic APL cells contain dense coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus with frequent faggot cells, whereas these cells appear nearly agranular.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma / Sézary cells in blood
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are MPO negative with lymphoid markers and lack the strong diffuse MPO positivity characteristic of APL.
